ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level ratio; predominantly low-intensity (near-black) pixels with small clusters of high-intensity (white) pixels accounting for less than 5% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark pigmentation across the majority of the visible fluke. Focal, high-contrast white pixel clusters are mapped to the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Sparse, circular, low-intensity white pixel mottling is visible on the medial portion of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped notch with a measured angle of approximately 90 degrees and a well-defined central convergence point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration across the entire continuous boundary. The left lobe exhibits low-amplitude, high-frequency peaks, while the right lobe distal edge displays higher-amplitude, jagged topographic variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical bi-concave curve sweeping upward and outward from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-intensity pixels at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization. Several distinct, approximately circular white-ringed scars are visible on the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization at the lateral tips of both lobes; scattered circular scarring on the left lobe surface.
